A new loading animation, and every package now carries the licenses of the code inside it. Website and docs: https://bong-water-water-bong.github.io/ytui/

## Download

| Platform | Package | Notes |
|---|---|---|
| Windows 10/11 (x64) | `ytui-v2026.10.19-windows-x86_64.zip` | Unzip and run `ytui.exe` in **Windows Terminal**. |
| Linux (x86_64) | `ytui-v2026.10.19-linux-x86_64.tar.gz` | |
| macOS (Apple Silicon) | `ytui-v2026.10.19-macos-arm64.tar.gz` | |

Each package holds `ytui` (or `ytui.exe`), `README.md`, `LICENSE` and `THIRD-PARTY-LICENSES.md`. You also need `yt-dlp`, `ffmpeg` and a JavaScript runtime (`deno` or Node.js) on your PATH, and a truecolour terminal. On Windows: `winget install yt-dlp.yt-dlp Gyan.FFmpeg DenoLand.Deno`.

Checksums are in `SHA256SUMS.txt`.

## What's new

- **Dot-reveal loader:** while a video loads, dots spread out from the centre of the player and pulse in rings, taking the colours of the thumbnail so the picture assembles out of dots. The idea comes from [DIVAE](https://github.com/intriXlabs/DIVAE). It shows on the watch page, in the miniplayer and fullscreen.
- **Licenses in every package:** `THIRD-PARTY-LICENSES.md` lists the 186 open-source Rust crates ytui is built from, with their license texts. Every source file now carries its copyright line and an SPDX MIT tag. ytui itself stays MIT.
